description: Creator / influencer monetization models — how an audience is turned into income. A registry of model SPECS (how it earns, what it needs, when it fits, the main risk), not advice; pointers, never truth. Public/illustrative patterns only; no real persons, accounts, or PII. Composes with self_employment_models (the solo variants) and business_models (the value-capture parent). serves_truth=false.

models.name: Brand sponsorship
models.fits: an engaged niche a brand wants to reach

models.name: Affiliate marketing
models.earns: commission on sales via tracked links/codes

models.name: Paid membership / subscription
models.needs: a superfan core + a recurring value

models.name: UGC creation (paid content for brands)
models.earns: paid to MAKE content brands post (not your audience)
models.needs: production skill, not necessarily a big following
models.fits: creators who'd rather make than build an audience

models.name: Own digital product / course
models.earns: sell a course/preset/template to the audience
models.fits: an audience with a clear skill gap

models.name: Platform ad revenue share
models.earns: a cut of ad revenue on views
models.needs: scale + watch-time on a sharing platform

models.name: Long-term ambassador / licensing
models.earns: ongoing retainer to represent/license a brand
